newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican drug lord's mother says he has died.
newsitem.headline: Mexican drug lord's mother says he has died.

text.p: The mother of Mexico's most wanted drug lord, Amado Carrillo Fuentes, told reporters that her son has died, Televisa news network said on Saturday.

Televisa said Aurora Fuentes de Carrillo, the capo's mother, announced her son's death to waiting reporters at her home in the northwestern state of Sinaloa. No official confirmation of the death was available.

The attorney general's office said in a statement it could not confirm Carrillo's death despite the family's report. It added that it began hearing unconfirmed reports of Carrillo's death late on Friday.
"This confirmation must wait until we have had access to the corpse and there has been a medical examination," the statement said.
Radio reports earlier said the drug lord died of a heart attack during surgery in Mexico City, but they gave no source. They said the body would be flown to Sinaloa later in the day.
Televisa reporter Enrique Gil said in a live telephone report from the village of Guamuchilito in Sinaloa that Carrillo's mother had just told waiting journalists: "The rumour is confirmed."
